field.name: $MIRRTEXT
field.dxfTableMeaning: The phrase 'mirror text if nonzero' describes the Boolean effect; the system-variable reference enumerates the accepted integer values as 0 and 1. These statements are compatible.

implementation.dxfOutput: HEADER preflight validates canonical dollar/bare aliases, integer variant type, group code 70, and the documented 0/1 domain before output. Invalid values are refused atomically; tolerant input remains unchanged.
implementation.semanticLimit: Field-domain admission only; native MIRROR command behavior and rendered result are not qualified.

coverage: ASCII/Binary output and typed readback for values 0 and 1.
Out-of-domain values, wrong variant types, wrong group codes, and duplicate dollar/bare aliases fail atomically.
Failed writes permit corrected same-writer retries in both encodings.
Tolerant ASCII input retains unsupported integer values.
